cli_discovery.notes: Not found on system PATH or within venv/Scripts

manual_activation_procedure: 1. Sign in to Kaggle at https://www.kaggle.com
2. Complete SMS phone verification in Account Settings (mandatory for GPU accelerators and internet access)
3. Navigate to Account Settings -> API section -> click 'Create New Token'
4. This downloads 'kaggle.json'. Move it to 'C:\Users\Dheeraj\.kaggle\kaggle.json' (or set environment variables KAGGLE_USERNAME and KAGGLE_KEY)
5. Install Kaggle CLI in project virtual environment: 'pip install kaggle'
security_note: No credentials were requested in chat or stored by the assistant. Follow manual setup only.
